review.notes: Seeded sample: all 15 sections. Read Lazard (1962) at (1.7)-(1.11), Propositions 1-4 and (4.11)-(4.13); Kedlaya's Newton-polygon notes at Corollary 3 and Theorem 7; KedlayaNumerical at Theorem 16. Koblitz, BGR, Neukirch and Washington are paywalled (uncertified). For NSW the service returned only the authors' landing page. Automatic checks all passed; the dependency check reports 0 problems. Suggested.lean elaborates with sorry as the only warning, and its six signatures match the README. All 333 README names resolve at the pins with #check. None of the six Lean targets is proved at the pin, and a one-tactic probe closes none. The 18 Checks and 28 examples were recomputed and are true. Finding R01: the radius formula is stated without the infinite-support hypothesis (false for polynomials) in the Suggested.lean docstring, the README overview and the Layer 5 introduction.
